[p align="start"]
We would like to inform you that the server patch has been completed as of November 9 (Mon) 07:00 (UTC).
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]We once again apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and will continue to do our best to provide a smoother service.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Please completely close the game and reconnect to download the new data.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]A server patch is scheduled to ensure a more stable gameplay environment.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]Please note that the server patch will be applied properly once you completely close and reconnect to the game. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]✦ Patch Schedule
[p align="start"]- November 9 (Mon) 06:00 - 07:00 (UTC)
[p align="start"]* The server patch will be applied once you completely close and reconnect to the game.
[p align="start"]* You may be temporarily disconnected from the game, and you will be able to play normally after reconnecting.
[p align="start"]
[p align="start"]✦ Apology Compensation

[p align="start"]- We sincerely apologize to all Star Guardians who experienced inconvenience due to issues related to the Knighthood Boss Battle. As a token of our apology, compensation will be distributed as detailed below.

Ranking settlement rewards for the Knighthood Boss Battle held from November 2 (Mon) 07:00 (UTC) until the November 9 (Mon) server patch will be distributed equally to all Star Guardians who participated in the Knighthood Boss Battle.: [p align="start"]- Ranking Settlement Reward: Knighthood Coin x50: * Knighthood Boss Battle ranking settlement rewards can be claimed by accessing the \ menu.: [p align="start"]✦ Patch Details: [p align="start"]- Fixed an issue where players do not take damage from certain attack patterns of ‘Demonic Beast Akumu’ in certain situations during the Knighthood Boss Battle: [p align="start"]- Fixed an issue where the Defense buff effect of ‘Demonic Beast Akumu’ is removed in certain situations during the Knighthood Boss Battle: [p align="start"]- Fixed an issue where some 「Corrupted」 monsters would appear in unintended locations when a 「Corruption」 Colony spawned in the ‘Giant Bird’s Nest’ region: [p align="start"]: [p align="start"]✦ Notes: [p align="start"]- You may be temporarily disconnected from the game during the server patch. If this occurs, please reconnect to continue playing normally.: [p align="start"]- Please completely exit the game and install the latest update on your platform.: [p align="start"]- Temporary connection instability may occur during the server patch.: [p align="start"]: [p align="start"]We will continue to do our best to provide a more stable gameplay environment.: [p align="start"]: [p align="start"]Thank you.

Greetings, Star Guardians!
Here are the details for the Version 2.3 Update.
\[Version 2.3 Content Overview]
✦ New Hero
\ Estia

Weapon & Element: 1. Rapier - Attacker (Cold): 2. Wand - Warden (Holy): 3. Grimoire - Support (Cold): * You can obtain ‘\ Estia’ from \[Estia Pick Up – The Power to Neutralize Pollution].: ※ As the temporary maintenance schedule has been changed from the previously announced November 4 (Wed) to November 5 (Thu), the opening schedules for some events and content have been adjusted accordingly. (Added on November 3 (Tue) 10:40 (UTC)): ✦ New Events: ‘Estia Pick Up – The Power to Neutralize Pollution’: Event Period: After the October 28 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the November 18 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC)
The drop rate for ‘\ Estia’ is increased in \[The Power to Neutralize Pollution].

The \[The Power to Neutralize Pollution] draw can be performed using ‘Hero Pick Up Draw Tickets’.: ‘Exclusive Skin - Dance of Shimmering Waters’: Event Period: After the October 28 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the November 18 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC)
The ‘Breath of the Water Spirit’, obtainable as a Top Tier Reward from \[Dance of Shimmering Waters], is an Outfit Skin for the hero ‘Estia’ and can be equipped to ‘\ Estia’.

All rewards, including the Outfit Skin ‘Breath of the Water Spirit’ and Weapon Skin ‘Pure Tide’ of ‘\ Estia’, are guaranteed within 10 draws.: * ‘Skins’ only change appearance when equipped and do not affect stats, skill effects, or any other attributes.: * The Weapon Skin ‘Pure Tide’ can be equipped on \ Estia’s ‘Rapier’ weapon.
The first draw is free, and from the second draw onward, you can perform draws using ‘Exclusive Skin Draw Tickets’.

Following the October 28 (Wed) update, Skin Draw rewards have been improved. Obtainable items and detailed probability information can be checked through \[Rate Info] at the bottom-left of the event screen.: ‘Clotho Pick Up - Enigmatic Helper’: Event Period: After the October 28 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the November 18 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC)
The drop rate for ‘\ Clotho’ is increased in \[Enigmatic Helper].
The \[Enigmatic Helper] draw can be performed using ‘Hero Pick Up Draw Tickets’.

The ‘120th Draw Bonus’ for \[Enigmatic Helper] will not be reset separately, and your previous progress will carry over and be displayed.: * If you have previously claimed the ‘120th Draw Bonus’ from this ‘Hero Pick Up’, the ‘120th Draw Bonus’ will not be displayed when the same ‘Hero Pick Up’ returns in the future. (Added on October 30 (Fri) 07:54 (UTC)): ‘Exclusive Skin - Moonlight Across the Dawn’: Event Period: After the October 28 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the November 18 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC)
The ‘Dawn Moon's Play’, obtainable as a Top Tier Reward from \[Moonlight Across the Dawn], is an Outfit Skin for the hero ‘Clotho’ and can be equipped to ‘\ Clotho’.

All rewards, including the Outfit Skin ‘Dawn Moon's Play’ and Weapon Skin ‘Sacred Sword Sephiora’ of ‘\ Clotho’, are guaranteed within 10 draws.: * ‘Skins’ only change appearance when equipped and do not affect stats, skill effects, or any other attributes.: * The Weapon Skin ‘Sacred Sword Sephiora’ can be equipped on \ Clotho’s ‘Rapier’ weapon.
The first draw is free, and from the second draw onward, you can perform draws using ‘Exclusive Skin Draw Tickets’.

Following the October 28 (Wed) update, if you previously made draws in \[Clotho Exclusive Skin - Moonlight Across the Dawn], your draw progress will carry over with the improved rewards when the event opens.: * Ex) If you previously completed up to the 5th draw, you will be able to continue from the 6th draw in this event.: * If you used the free draw (1st draw) during the previous \[Moonlight Across the Dawn] event, an additional free draw will not be provided.: ‘Hero Estia Trial Event’: Event Period: After the October 28 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the November 18 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC)
Try out ‘\ Estia’ and complete the challenge to earn rewards such as Star Fragments and Supreme Mastery EXP.

The hero provided in the Trial Dungeon is fully upgraded, with only Outfit and Weapon Skins equipped.: ‘Event Story - Mighty Freaky Circus’: Event Period: After the October 28 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the November 18 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC)
Complete the ‘Mighty Freaky Circus’ Event Story, defeat bosses, and clear Event Missions to earn Star Fragments and ‘Used Entry Tickets’.
Use ‘Used Entry Tickets’ at the Event Exchange Shop to exchange for various rewards.
Clear \[The Truth] in the Event Quest ‘Endless Night’ during the event period to unlock the Event Boss Challenge.
The Event Boss Challenge ‘Star of the Nightmare’ is available in \, \, \, and \ difficulties.

Open Reward Cubes in the Event Boss Challenge ‘Star of the Nightmare’ using the dedicated event currency, ‘Circus Entry Tickets’.: * Up to 2 ‘Circus Entry Tickets’ are provided daily, resetting every day at 07:00 (UTC).
Obtain the Event Food items ‘Red Candy’ and ‘Blue Candy’ through Event Daily Missions and the Event Exchange Shop. These items grant beneficial buff effects when battling ‘Star of the Nightmare’.

Exchange ‘Used Entry Tickets’ at the Event Exchange Shop for various rewards, including ‘Golden Halloween Chance Baskets’, ‘Halloween Chance Baskets’, and ‘Sweet Pumpkin Candy’ Accessories.: ‘Deadly Sins, Assemble! - Deadly Sins, Assemble!’: Event Period: After the October 28 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the November 18 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC)
Complete Event Missions through the mini-game during the event period to earn ‘Plushie-filled Oak Casks’ as mission rewards.

In the ‘Deadly Sins, Assemble!’ mini-game, plushies that fall into the oak cask will merge into a plushie of the next level when they touch an identical plushie. Merge as many plushies as possible to earn a higher score.: * You can check the Leaderboard using the ‘ranking’ icon at the bottom of the screen. No separate leaderboard rewards will be provided.

Use ‘Plushie-filled Oak Casks’ at the Event Exchange Shop to exchange for various rewards, including an event Title, ‘Sweet Pumpkin Candy Ring’, ‘Golden Halloween Chance Baskets’, and ‘Halloween Chance Baskets’.: ‘Eve Check-In Event - Update Eve Check-In Event’: Event Period: After the November 4 (Wed) 16:00Maintenance - Until the November 18 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC)
Simply check in during the event period to receive a variety of growth rewards over 14 days, including Hero Pick Up Draw Tickets, Regular Hero Draw Tickets, and Radiant Potions of Charm.

Check-In Event rewards can be claimed once per day upon logging in, with each day resetting at 07:00 (UTC).: * You can receive Check-In rewards for each day you log in during the event period.: ‘Penguin Smash! - Penguin Smash!’: Event Period: After the November 4 (Wed) 16:00Maintenance - Until the November 18 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC)

Help Estia with Penguin Smash to earn various rewards, including Platinum Ingots, Radiant Potions of Charm, Tailor’s Stitching Needles, and Engraver’s Fabric Scissors. Enter ‘Fever Time’ to earn additional Star Fragments.

Participate in the event using ‘Penguin Smash Event Tickets’, which can be obtained through Event Missions.: ‘Swiftest Showdown - Time Attack Challenge!’: Event Period: After the November 4 (Wed) 16:00Maintenance - Until the November 18 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC)
The ‘Time Attack Challenge!’ content will open sequentially from Day 1 through Day 6 during the event period.

Upon clearing each day’s content and completing the missions in \[Time Attack Challenge! Missions], you can obtain up to 2,400 Star Fragments.: * An issue has been identified where the Gold reward for successfully completing the ‘Time Attack Challenge!’ challenge in \[Swiftest Showdown - Time Attack Challenge!] is incorrectly set to ‘80K’ instead of ‘800K’. This issue will be fixed during the November 5 (Thu) temporary maintenance. (Added on November 4 (Wed) 07:42 (UTC)): ‘A Joyful Moment - Exciting Cube Unboxing!’ (Added on November 3 (Tue) 10:40 (UTC)): Event Period: November 4 (Wed) 07:00 - Until the November 18 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC)

During the event period, you can claim mission rewards such as Cube Keys, Regular Hero Draw Tickets, Transcendence Engraving Stones, and Transcendence Refinement Stones based on the number of Cube Keys used for mission progress.: * The number of Cube Keys consumed will accumulate during the event period and count toward mission progress.
Upon completing all missions and reaching the final mission progress milestone, you can claim the final completion reward.: ✦ New Content: Raid ‘Taranis’s Sanctuary’ \ Difficulty Added

\ difficulty will be added to the Raid ‘Taranis’s Sanctuary’.: \[Key & Weekly Reward Reset]: * With the addition of \ difficulty, ‘Mystic Keys’, ‘Chaos Keys’, and Weekly Reward claim counts will be reset during the October 28 (Wed) Maintenance.: * After the Version 2.3 update, only the number of ‘Mystic Keys’, ‘Chaos Keys’, and Weekly Reward claims used before the update will be replenished.: * The number of exchanges (purchases) available at the Raid Exchange Shop will not be reset. ‘Mystic Keys’ and ‘Chaos Keys’ will only be replenished up to their default maximum of 2 each.: \[Transcendence Difficulty]
\ difficulty will use ‘Mystic Keys’, the same as \ difficulty.
\ difficulty will not have a separate time limit or Pledges.: \[New Equipment]
A new higher-tier equipment set, ‘Greed Incarnate’, will be added to \ difficulty with a fixed Quality of 170.

Defeating Elite Monsters in \ difficulty will have a chance to grant equipment from either the ‘Greed Incarnate’ or ‘Greedy Ruler’ sets.: * ‘Greedy Ruler’ armor will appear with a fixed Quality of 160.: * The types of equipment options for each part of the ‘Greed Incarnate’ and ‘Greedy Ruler’ sets are fixed, while the option values will be random.: \[Weekly Rewards]

‘Greed Incarnate Chance Chests’ will be added to the Weekly Rewards for \ difficulty.: ‘Ranking Season - To the Top: Ranking Season 7’ Open: Season 7 Period: After the October 28 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the November 18 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC): \[Eligible Content]

During Season 7, Leaderboards will be available for the following content: • Event Boss Challenge: \ ‘Star of the Nightmare’: • Timespace Junction: Season 2 Sectors 7 & 8: * Existing clear records will be reset at the start of the season.: \[Leaderboard Access & Records]

Leaderboards can be viewed from the bulletin board in the East District of ‘Liones Castle’ or by selecting the \ tab at the bottom of \[Menu (☰)].: * Records from party play will not be included in the Leaderboard rankings.: * A \ button will be added to the main entry screen of the applicable content, allowing you to view the Leaderboard directly.: * If you leave after clearing the content but before the clear is fully processed, the record will not be reflected on the Leaderboard.: \[Ranking Criteria]

If clear times are identical, the same rank will be displayed. Ranking order will be determined based on detailed clear times not displayed in-game, team Combat Class, and other factors.: * Leaderboards cannot be viewed during the season-end period.: \[Ranking Rewards]
After the season ends, all Star Guardians who participated in the Leaderboard will receive 10 ‘Laurels of Glory’, regardless of rank.

\ tab Achievements, unlocked based on the number of ‘Laurels of Glory’ obtained, offer various rewards including Star Fragments, emotes, and pets.: * Ranking rewards will be sent to your mailbox after the season ends.: Timespace Junction Sector Unlock

‘Timespace Junction Season 2’ Sectors will unlock as follows: * Normal/Ranked Sector 7: After the November 4 (Wed) 07:00 (UTC)Maintenance: Normal/Ranked Sector 8: November 11 (Wed) 07:00 (UTC): 'Hawk Pass' Season VI Open

After the October 28 (Wed) update, ‘Hawk Pass’ Season VI will begin.: * With the start of ‘Hawk Pass’ Season VI, existing Hawk Pass products and levels will be reset.: * ‘Hawk Pass Plus’ & ‘Premium Hawk Pass’ bundles will become unavailable for purchase 1 day before the season ends.
During the Hawk Pass period, you can level up through missions to earn Free Rewards. By purchasing the ‘Hawk Pass’, you can also claim Plus Rewards in addition to the Free Rewards.
By purchasing the ‘Hawk Pass Plus’ and ‘Premium Hawk Pass’, you can unlock the Plus Rewards.

Upon purchasing the ‘Hawk Pass Plus’ and ‘Premium Hawk Pass’, Bonus Rewards will be granted immediately and can be claimed from your mailbox.: * The purchase period and reset timing for the ‘Hawk Pass’ can be checked in-game for more details.: ▶ 'Hawk Pass' Season VI Open Notice: ✦ New Memory of Dimensions Quest Added
A new quest, \[The Holy Knight’s Sword], will be added to ‘Memory of Dimensions'.: \[How to Access]
Select an unlocked quest from \[Menu (☰)] → \[『Book of Stars』] → \[Memory of Dimensions], then select \ to begin.
Clear the quest to obtain various rewards, including Star Fragments.: \[Quest Progression]

Only one ‘Memory of Dimensions’ quest can be progressed at a time. If you already have a quest in progress, you cannot begin another until the current quest is complete.: * If you leave before completing a quest, your progress will be saved, and you can continue from where you left off by selecting \.
‘Memory of Dimensions’ is single-player content and cannot be played while in a party. You also cannot create or join a party while a quest is in progress.: ✦ New Boss Challenge Missions Added
4 new missions will be added to the \ difficulty missions for each Boss Challenge where \ difficulty is available.

Boss Challenge Missions can only be completed in solo play, and each reward can be obtained once.: * Mission rewards will be granted automatically upon completing the corresponding mission in \ difficulty.: ✦ World Level 5 Content Unlocked
World Level 5 will be unlocked after the November 5 (Thu)4 (Wed) maintenance upon reaching 『Book of Stars』 Lv. 50.
Along with the unlock of World Level 5, the 『Book of Stars』 level cap will be expanded from Lv. 50 to Lv. 59. (Added on November 3 (Tue) 10:40 (UTC))

At World Level 5, Field Bosses in a 「Corruption」 Frenzy state will appear in the field. Defeating 「Corrupted」 Field Bosses will grant new items, including currency used in the new growth system, ‘Star Map’.: \

「Corruption」 Frenzy occurs in two forms: • 「Corruption」 Frenzy: A personal encounter that occurs only in your own field and can be played solo or while in a party.: • Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy: A multiplayer encounter that occurs across the entire server at specific times, allowing up to 15 players to be matched together.
Reward Cubes from 「Corruption」 Frenzy can be opened using ‘Cube Keys’, while Reward Cubes from Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy can be opened without using any additional currency.
Rewards can be obtained up to 3 times per day from each of 「Corruption」 Frenzy and Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy.

There is no separate daily reward limit for 「Corruption」 Frenzy, while rewards from Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy can be obtained up to 3 times per day. (Added on November 6 (Fri) 08:53 (UTC)): * Reward Cubes from 「Corruption」 Frenzy and Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy cannot be obtained twice, and Khala’s Adventure Skill does not apply to them.

If 「Corruption」 Frenzy is active in a region, the dome for Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy will not be displayed. You must purify the personal 「Corruption」 area and leave that region before the multiplayer dome becomes visible.: \[「Corruption」 Frenzy]

While World Level 5 is active, a gauge will be displayed at the top of the main screen. The gauge fills regardless of whether you are logged in, and once it is full, a 「Corruption」 event will occur in the field.: * 「Corruption」 can occur even if a 「Corrupted」 Field Boss is already present, with up to 3 different types of Field Bosses becoming 「Corrupted」.: * Gathering, mining, quests, and other activities cannot be progressed in areas with a 「Corrupted」 Field Boss.
If a player, including a party member, is currently in the region where 「Corruption」 is set to occur, 「Corruption」 will not begin until the area is vacated.

When 「Corruption」 Frenzy occurs, 3 「Corruption」 Colonies will be generated at random in the region of the affected Field Boss. Purifying the 「Abyss Flower」 of a 「Corruption」 Colony using the 『Book of Stars』 will remove one enhancement effect from the 「Corrupted」 Field Boss.: * 「Corrupted」 Field Bosses can have up to 3 enhancement effects and can still be challenged without purifying any 「Corruption」 Colonies.

When defeating a 「Corrupted」 Field Boss while in a party, party members can also open the Reward Cube if a 「Corruption」 Frenzy is active in their own world. Upon claiming the reward, the oldest 「Corruption」 Frenzy in their own world will be purified.: * Party members without an active 「Corruption」 Frenzy in their own world cannot claim the Reward Cube.

「Corrupted」 Field Bosses will remain until defeated. If you wish to remove the 「Corruption」 without battling the boss, select \[Force Purify] from the boss information on the World Map.: * No rewards can be obtained when using \[Force Purify].: * 「Corrupted」 Field Bosses will not be displayed when switching to World Levels 1 - 4, but will reappear when World Level 5 is selected again.: \[Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy]
Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy will occur at the following times each week, with notifications sent to all World Level 5 players across the server.

The Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy will occur a total of 9 times each week from Friday through Monday, with notifications sent to all World Level 5 players across the server when it occurs. (Added on November 3 (Tue) 10:40 (UTC)
• Thursday: 18:00
• Monday: 02:00
* Each Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy will be available for 3 hours.

A dome will appear in the region of the affected 「Corrupted」 Field Boss. Interact with the dome to begin matchmaking.: * A minimum of 10 and up to 15 players can enter together. You can attempt \[Party Matchmaking] either solo or in a party of up to 5 players.: * The Field Bosses ‘Gray Demon’ and ‘Red Demon’ will be temporarily excluded from Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy occurring after the November 5 (Thu) maintenance. A separate notice will be provided once they are added at a later date. (Added on November 3 (Tue) 10:58 (UTC)): * The Field Bosses ‘Gray Demon’ and ‘Red Demon’ will be included in the Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy following the November 5 (Thu) maintenance. (Added on November 6 (Fri) 02:25 (UTC))
Even if you are defeated while battling the 「Corrupted」 Field Boss, you can revive and continue the battle without any limit on the number of revivals.
A Reward Cube will appear only for players who have dealt damage to the 「Corrupted」 Field Boss at least once.

There is no limit to the number of entries, but rewards can only be obtained up to 3 times per day. After obtaining rewards 3 times in a day, Reward Cubes will no longer appear even if you defeat a 「Corrupted」 Field Boss.: ✦ ‘Star Map’ System Added
After the November 5 (Thu)4 (Wed) maintenance, a new ‘Star Map’ tab will be added under \[Menu (☰)] → \[『Book of Stars』].

‘Star Map’ consists of 1062 tiers and allows you to permanently increase combat stats (Attack/Defense/HP) using items obtained after battling 「Corrupted」 Field Bosses at World Level 5. (Updated on November 6 (Fri) 08:53 (UTC)): \[Star Paths]
‘Star Map’ is divided into 3 categories: Attack, Defense, and HP. Each ‘Star Map’ contains a Star Path consisting of 15 Star Seeds.

Star Paths can be filled by infusing ‘Attack Essence’, ‘Defense Essence’, or ‘HP Essence’ obtained from Reward Cubes after defeating Field Bosses in 「Corruption」 Frenzy or Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy states.
Once all 3 Attack/Defense/HP Star Paths are activated, you can use Hero Points to advance the ‘Star Map’ to the next tier. Advancing to the next tier will also grant a ‘Lodestar’.: \[Hero Points]

Hero Points are granted the first time you obtain a hero. You can check your current points under \[Current Hero Points] at the top right.: * No additional Hero Points are granted when obtaining duplicate heroes or unlocking Potential.: * After the November 5 (Thu)4 (Wed) maintenance, Hero Points will be granted retroactively based on the heroes you have already obtained.: \[Star Clusters]

Each ‘Star Map’ contains its own Star Clusters, which can be unlocked based on the number of ‘Lodestars’ you own.: * Star Clusters can be unlocked based on the number of ‘Lodestars’ you own, and ‘Lodestars’ are not consumed when unlocking them.: \

Each Star Cluster contains 5 Apastrons. Apastrons can be unlocked using ‘Condensed Star Essence’ obtained from Reward Cubes after defeating Field Bosses in 「Corruption」 Frenzy or Massive 「Corruption」 Frenzy states.

Unlocked Apastrons can be upgraded up to Tier 3 using Mastery EXP items and Gold, granting additional stats at each tier.: * Upgraded ‘Star Seeds’, ‘Star Paths’, as well as unlocked ‘Apastrons’ cannot be reset.: New Craftable Items & Recipes Added
A new craftable weapon will be added.
Shadow Rupture Rapier: Other New Content
2 new Achievements related to the Memory of Dimensions and Estia will be added.: \[Content & System Improvements]: ✦ Enchantment & Engraved Equipment Bonus Change Improvements
A new feature will be added that allows you to lock only the desired Bonuses when changing Enchantment or Engraved Equipment Bonuses.
For Engraved Equipment Bonuses, up to 2 Bonuses can be locked. For Enchantment, all Bonuses can be locked except for at least 1 Bonus to be changed.
Using the Bonus Lock feature will not require any additional currency and can be used in the same way as before.

When changing Enchantment Bonuses, if a different type of Spell Bead is used, the lock status will be reset, and the Bonus Lock feature cannot be used.: ✦ Knighthood Boss Battle ‘Demonic Beast Akumu’ Combat Improvements

Knighthood Boss Battle will be temporarily unavailable after the weekly reset on November 2 (Mon) at 07:00 (UTC) in preparation for the revamp scheduled for the November 5 (Thu)4 (Wed) maintenance.: * The new Knighthood Boss Battle season will open after the November 5 (Thu)4 (Wed) maintenance.
The battle time for Knighthood Boss Battle ‘Demonic Beast Akumu’ will be reduced from 5 minutes to 4 minutes.

‘Demonic Beast Akumu’ has an effect that increases its base Defense by 500%. Each time it is hit by one of the 5 Elements (Fire, Lightning, Wind, Earth, Cold), its Defense will be reduced by 10% for 3 sec5 sec. (Up to 10 times) (Updated on November 6 (Fri) 02:25 (UTC))
Element Stones that appear during the battle against ‘Demonic Beast Akumu’ will now appear more quickly than before.
Players who destroy an Element Stone will receive a beneficial buff. If all Element Stones are destroyed, ‘Demonic Beast Akumu’ will enter a Groggy state and take heavy damage while Groggy.
During the battle against ‘Demonic Beast Akumu’, all players will receive an additional buff after a certain amount of time has passed.
Some stats and balance values for Knighthood Boss Battle ‘Demonic Beast Akumu’ will be adjusted.: \[Bug Fixes & Improvements]: ✦ Quests & Content: Raid
The Block Rate of ‘Black Rook’ will be reduced across all difficulties of the Raid ‘Taranis’s Sanctuary’.
When entering a Raid difficulty other than the highest difficulty, a pop-up regarding Weekly Reward claim consumption will now be displayed.: Knighthood
The sorting of recommended Knighthoods on the \[Join Knighthood] screen will be improved.

Fixed issues occurring during Knighthood content: • Fixed an issue where players could be hit by Demonic Beast Akumu’s skills even when outside the skill range during the Knighthood Boss Battle ‘Demonic Beast Akumu’: Dungeon & Boss Challenge

Fixed issues occurring during Boss Challenges: • Fixed an issue where the Quality of the ‘Tyrant Dragon’s Black Heart Top’ obtained from a higher difficulty in Boss Challenge ‘Draco King Drake’ was lower than that from a lower difficulty: • Fixed an issue where the safe zone would not be displayed before the battle started after entering Boss Challenge ‘Beast of Destruction, Indura Monspeet’ under certain conditions: • Fixed an issue where the ‘Clear without using a Combined Attack’ mission would not be completed under certain conditions in \ difficulty of Boss Challenge ‘Draco King Drake’ even when a Combined Attack was not used (Added on October 28 (Wed) 01:50 (UTC)): Other
The tutorial skip feature displayed when starting the game for the first time will be removed.
The initial tutorial for ‘Memory of Dimensions’ will be removed.

[p align="start"]We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused and will continue to do our best to provide a more stable gameplay environment.

Regarding the currently available \ difficulty Boss Challenges for Monspeet and Guila, we have identified an unintended bug with the ‘Restart’ feature that was introduced to make repeated attempts smoother.
We sincerely apologize to all Star Guardians who have dedicated significant time and effort to competing in the rankings for not being able to provide a fair and stable environment.

Unfortunately, rewards based on ranking placement will not be distributed. Instead, some of the ranking rewards will be provided as apology compensation to all Star Guardians who clear either of the two \ difficulty Boss Challenges.

We once again sincerely apologize to all Star Guardians who were looking forward to the Boss Challenge \ difficulty Time Attack introduced with Version 2.0 for not being able to deliver the experience you had hoped for.

\ difficulty Time Attacks will continue to be available going forward. However, until system improvements addressing this issue have been completed, there will be no Titles or differences in rewards based on ranking placement, and all participants will receive the same rewards.
We will work to address this issue as soon as possible and provide a stable and fair competitive environment.

\[「The Traitor's Street」 Version 2.0 Content Overview]
✦ New Hero
\ Ban

Weapon & Element: 1. Nunchaku- Attacker (Physical): 2. Greatsword - Attacker (Earth): 3. (Added on September 15 (Tue) 10:10 (UTC)): ‘Ban Pick Up – The Righteous Outlaw’: Event Period: After the August 26 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the September 16 (Wed)17 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC)

The \[The Righteous Outlaw] draw can be performed using ‘Hero Pick Up Draw Tickets’.: ‘Exclusive Skin - Ready for Battle’: Event Period: After the August 26 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the September 16 (Wed)17 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC)
The ‘Irreverent Holy Knight’, obtainable as a Top Tier Reward from \[Ready for Battle], is an Outfit Skin for the hero ‘Ban’ and can be equipped to ‘\ Ban’.

All rewards, including the Outfit Skin ‘Irreverent Holy Knight’ and Weapon Skin ‘Demon Cudgel Vesta’ of ‘\ Ban’, are guaranteed within 10 draws.: * ‘Skins’ only change appearance when equipped and do not affect stats, skill effects, or any other attributes.: * The ‘Demon Cudgel Vesta’ can be equipped as a ‘Nunchaku’ weapon on ‘\ Ban’.

The first draw is free, and from the second draw onward, you can perform draws using ‘Exclusive Skin Draw Tickets’.: ‘Hero Ban Trial Event’: Event Period: After the August 26 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the September 16 (Wed)17 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC)
Try out ‘\ Ban’ and complete the challenge to earn rewards such as Star Fragments and Supreme Mastery EXP.

The trial dungeon hero is fully upgraded, with only Outfit and Weapon Skins applied.: ‘A Celebration All Our Own - A Gift from ’: Event Period: After the August 26 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the October 7 (Wed)8 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC)
During the event period, ‘A Gift from ’ quests will open sequentially from Day 1 through Day 8.

Interact with \[The Seven Deadly Sins] and ‘Hawk’ to earn up to 16 Hero Pick Up Draw Tickets and 20 Regular Hero Draw Tickets.: ‘Special Check-In Stamp - Half-Anniversary Reward Selection Check-In Event’: Event Period: After the August 26 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the October 7 (Wed)8 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC)
By checking in during the event period, you can choose one of two rewards each day for 14 days to receive as your check-in reward.
Upon claiming all 14 days of check-in rewards, you can additionally receive all of the remaining rewards you did not choose on each day as a special bonus reward.
The Check-In Event resets every day at 07:00 (UTC).: ‘Lucky Snatch - Spin, Orb of Greed.’: Event Period: After the August 26 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the September 16 (Wed)17 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC)
Use ‘Orbs of Greed’ obtained through Daily Missions for a lucky chance to win up to 30,000 ‘Star Fragments’.
Daily Missions reset every day at 07:00 (UTC), and you can obtain up to 3 ‘Orbs of Greed’ per day.: * ‘Orbs of Greed’ you have obtained will not reset separately during the event period.

The remaining reward quantity updates every minute, and once a reward’s quantity is fully claimed, it can no longer be obtained.: ‘Event Survey - Poll Draw Survey’: Event Period: After the August 26 (Wed) Maintenance - September 2 (Wed) 06:59:59 (UTC)

To celebrate the Half Anniversary, 6 candidate heroes have been selected from all Pick Up heroes that have appeared so far. During the event period, you can vote once per day for the 3 heroes you’d most like to see return.: * Poll Draw Candidate Heroes: Meliodas, Daisy, Escanor, Clotho, Merlin, Elizabeth: * Voting is only available for accounts that have completed the Netmarble Login, and vote counts reset every day at 07:00 (UTC).
On Day 1, you can vote for 3 heroes from the lineup of 6, and you can also select 1 additional hero from among the chosen 3 to cast 1 extra vote.
Starting from Day 2, after voting, you can select 1 random hero from the overall vote results and move 1 vote to a hero of your choice.
Voting results are updated as a combined total across all regions, refreshed daily at 07:00 (UTC).

Once a vote is submitted, it cannot be cancelled or changed.: ‘Echo of Jubilation - Star Memory, Unleashed!’: Event Period: After the August 26 (Wed) Maintenance - Until the October 7 (Wed)8 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC)
Earn payback rewards based on how many ‘Star Memories’ you consume during the event period, including ‘Star Fragments’, a ‘Regular SSR Hero Selection Ticket’, and the pet ‘Scorpy Beast Hawk’.

Upon completing all missions, you can additionally obtain Pick Up Hero Draw Tickets and Ban Emojis.: ‘Event Boss - Her Return’: Event Period: After the 2 (Wed)September 3 (Thu) Maintenance - September 23 (Wed) 06 : 59 : 59 (UTC)Until the September 16 (Wed Maintenance: * The event's open schedule has been updated. (Added on September 1 (Tue) 10:00 (UTC))

‘Mutated Magic Bead Tokens’ can be exchanged for rewards at the Event Exchange Shop.

Upon defeating ‘Beast of Destruction, Indura Monspeet’, you can obtain the following rewards and more: • ‘Twisted Hellfire Combat Boots’: • ‘Destroyer’s Obsession’ Armor Set, used as Engraved Equipment materials: • ‘Indura’s Condensed Magic’, used to craft the special weapon ‘Gluttonous Soul Nunchaku’: New Content ‘Labyrinth’: * The new ‘Labyrinth’ content has been excluded from this update as further review is required. Its release schedule will be announced at a later date. (Added on September 1 (Tue) 10:00 (UTC))

The new content ‘Labyrinth’, played using the Element and Position of the heroes you own, will open after the September 2 (Wed) maintenance (UTC).: * Labyrinth will open upon completing Main Quest ‘Situation in the Village’.: * You can enter by selecting the \ tab at the bottom of \[Menu (☰)].: * Labyrinth will reset every Monday at 07:00 (UTC).
Labyrinth is played using a separate HP called ‘Ember’, which you can hold up to a maximum of 50.
Before entering Labyrinth, you can select a Rental Pet to bring with you. The ‘Switch Pet’ feature will be available for free the first time and will cost 3 ‘Ember’ per switch afterward.

Upon entering, you can choose 1 of up to 4 Labyrinth Doors shown to you. Selecting a Door starts the corresponding Labyrinth, where you’ll deploy your heroes and Rental Pets according to its conditions.: * Each owned hero’s deployment count starts at 1 at Potential \[Tier 0] and increases alongside their Potential \, up to a maximum of 5 times at \[Tier 4].

Various choices are presented based on events that occur within Labyrinth. Depending on your choice, you may receive rewards that help your progress or penalties, such as losing Ember, based on chance.
Rewards accumulated while progressing through Labyrinth are granted upon settlement after completing Labyrinth.
If you leave in the middle of a Labyrinth run, your current progress will be saved, and you can continue via ‘Continue’.
Retrying during a Labyrinth run will reset your heroes, pets, Ember, and round progress entirely, starting from Round 1.: * The Retry feature can be used up to once per week.

‘Mysterious Gems’ obtained through playing Labyrinth can be exchanged for various items at the Labyrinth Shop.: * The Labyrinth Shop can be accessed by selecting the reward icon in the bottom right of the ‘Labyrinth’ main screen.: Ranking Season - To the Top: Ranking Season 4’ Open

If clear times are identical, the same rank will be displayed, and the order will be sorted based on detailed clear times not displayed in-game, team Combat Class, and other factors.: * Leaderboards cannot be viewed during the season-end period.
After the end of the season, Star Guardians who achieve certain rankings will receive special Title rewards and the ‘Laurel of Glory’.

\ tab Achievements, unlockable based on the number of ‘Laurels of Glory’ obtained, offer various rewards including Star Fragments, emotes, and pets.: * Ranking rewards will be sent to your mailbox after the season ends.: Timespace Junction Season 2
Season 2 Unlock Schedule: After the September 2 (Wed)September 3 (Thu) Maintenance: * The open schedule has been updated. (Added on September 1 (Thu) 10:00 (UTC))
‘Timespace Junction’ can be accessed from the bottom of \[Menu (☰)] and entered during the season period.
‘Timespace Junction’ is a stage-based content, with new Sectors expanding periodically.
‘Timespace Junction Season 2’ will be changed to allow you to choose and challenge any unlocked Sector you’d like.

Bosses in ‘Timespace Junction Season 2’ will appear sequentially, featuring both bosses that appeared in Season 1 and new bosses.: * Further details about ‘Timespace Junction Season 2’ will be announced separately at a later date.: ‘Transcendence Engraving/Refinement’ System Added

A new ‘Transcendence Engraving/Refinement’ system, which allows you to refine Engraved Equipment beyond +5, will be added.: * With the addition of the new system, Knighthood Boss Battle entry attempts will be reset during the August 26 (Wed) maintenance.: * As the Knighthood Boss Battle entry attempts will be reset, only the number of attempts used before the Version 2.0 update will be replenished after the Version 2.0 update.

Upon completing refinement up to +5, Transcendence Engraving and Transcendence Refinement will be unlocked. ‘Transcendence Engraving Stones’ can then be used to unlock additional Transcendence Refinement levels.: * ‘Transcendence Engraving Stones’ can be obtained from Boss Challenges and Dungeons at \ and \ difficulty, the ‘Labyrinth’ content, and crafting.: * ‘Transcendence Refinement Stones’ can be obtained from Boss Challenges and Dungeons at \ and \ difficulty, and the ‘Labyrinth’ content.

Transcendence Engraving has a chance to succeed or fail. Upon success, the engraving is completed. Upon failure, no changes occur and only the ‘Transcendence Engraving Stone’ is the materials used for Transcendence Engraving are consumed. (Updated on September 29 (Tue) 03:30 (UTC))

Transcendence Engraving allows you to unlock 3 additional Bonuses. Successfully unlocking all 3 grants 2 types of Transcendence Bonuses and 1 type of Transcendence Passive.: * At \[+5], \[+10], and \[+14], you can use ‘Transcendence Engraving Stones’ to unlock the next Transcendence Refinement level.: Raid \ Difficulty Added

Improved so that equipment (Engraved Equipment, Armor, Accessories) can be equipped separately for each of a hero’s 3 weapon types.

A weapon type tab will be added at the bottom of the \ screen when entering \[Hero Info].: * Only weapon type tabs for which equipment can be equipped will be activated, based on whether Shared Mastery is active.
Equipment can now be equipped simultaneously across all weapon types owned by a hero.

When selecting Armor \[Quick Equip] from the \, the currently selected hero’s active weapon types will be displayed, allowing you to select the desired weapon type to equip.
On a hero’s \ screen in \[Hero Info], selecting \ for a weapon with no equipment equipped will display an Armor equip notification pop-up.: ✦ ‘Battle Support Mode’ Platform Expansion
‘Battle Support Mode’, previously available first on the mobile platform, will now also be expanded to the PlayStation®5 and PC platforms.: ✦ Leaderboard ‘Previous Season Info’ Feature Improvements
The \[Previous Season] button, previously located on individual content leaderboards, will be moved to the bottom of the Leaderboard main screen.

Improved so that selecting the \[Previous Season Ranking Info] button allows you to view previous season information for Boss Challenges, Dungeons, and Timespace Junction, regardless of whether the current season is open.: ✦ Enhanced Combat Visibility
A new option, \[Combat View Assist], will be added under \ > \.

\[Combat View Assist] allows you to make combat effects render as transparent, regardless of whether they belong to your hero, allies, summons, or enemies.: * This feature is planned to be applied first to the PlayStation®5 and PC platforms, with mobile platform support planned for a later date.
A new option, \[Damage Number Display Limit], will be added under \ > \.
\[Damage Number Display Limit] lets you set the number of damage values displayed during combat, with Max / Medium / Min settings.

The maximum number of buff and debuff icons displayed on screen during gameplay will be adjusted based on whether they belong to a hero, party, boss, or normal monster.: * Only the displayed count will be adjusted, and the buff and debuff effects will continue to be applied normally.: \[Bug Fixes & Improvements]: ✦ Quests & Content: Raid

Fixed various issues occurring during progress in the Raid ‘Taranis’s Sanctuary’: • Fixed an issue where players could move abnormally through the terrain at the starting waiting area: • Fixed an issue where, after setting a Raid ‘Pledge’ and a crash occurred during party play, the Pledge reward would occasionally be unobtainable from the Reward Cube: • Fixed an issue where rewards would occasionally be unobtainable after clearing the Raid: Dungeon & Boss Challenge

Fixed various issues occurring during Boss Challenges: • Fixed an issue where, when defeating the boss ‘Galland of 「Truth」’ near the field boundary during combat, ‘Teranscendence Essence’ would drop outside the boundary: Features

‘Knighthood Combat Class Rankings’ will be added as a filter option in ‘Join Knighthood’ on the \ screen.

items.text: Greetings, Star Guardians.
The server patch has been completed as of June 9 (Tue) 06:35 (UTC).
Please reconnect to the game to ensure the patch is applied properly.
We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused and will continue to do our best to provide a more stable gameplay environment.
A server patch is scheduled to address issues related to the hero ‘Clotho’.

Following the fix, we understand that some Star Guardians may feel that the hero’s performance has been reduced compared to what they previously experienced. With this in mind, we plan to make partial improvements to the affected weapon skill and Engraved Equipment effects.
We sincerely apologize for any confusion caused by this issue. As a token of our apology, compensation will be distributed to all Star Guardians.
Please refer to the details below, and we will continue doing our best to provide a more stable gameplay environment.
✦ Patch Schedule
June 9 (Tue) 06:00 - 06:35 (UTC): * During the server patch, you may be disconnected from the game temporarily. If this occurs, please reconnect to continue playing normally.: ✦ Apology Compensation
Star Fragment x3,000
Element Spell Bead Selection Chest x10
Engraver's Fabric Scissors x3

Tailor's Stitching Needle x5: * Compensation will be distributed sequentially via the in-game mailbox after the server patch is completed and can be claimed until June 23 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC).: ✦ Patch Details: 1. Issue Fixes

Fixed an issue where the ‘Cold Attack Increase’ and ‘Cold Damage Increase’ from ‘Rune Ward’ stack with the ‘Stable Barrier’ buff granted by the Engraved Equipment ‘Head Scholar’s Formality’ when using the Ultimate Move ‘Frost Rune: Perfect Form’ of Clotho’s Grimoire weapon: 2. Balance Adjustments

Increased the ‘Rune Ward’ effect from Clotho’s Grimoire weapon Ultimate Move ‘Frost Rune: Perfect Form’: * Before: At max stacks, Cold Damage increases by 20%, and Cold Attack increases by 4.5% of the caster’s Max HP. (Max: 3000): After: At max stacks, Cold Damage increases by 40%, and Cold Attack increases by 6% of the caster’s Max HP. (Max: 4000): * The effect adjustment for the Ultimate Move ‘Frost Rune: Perfect Form’ will be applied sequentially following the June 9 (Tue) server patch. However, please note that the description text displayed in the buff icon granted during battle when using the Ultimate Move will be updated during the June 24 (Wed) maintenance.

Increased the \[Stable Barrier] effect of Clotho’s Engraved Equipment ‘Head Scholar’s Formality’: * Before: …all allied Cold heroes have their Crit Chance increased by 9%/12%/15% and Crit Damage by 4%/30%/36%.: After: …all allied Cold heroes have their Crit Chance increased by 10%/15%/20% and Crit Damage by 30%/40%/50%.: * The changes to the \[Stable Barrier] effect of ‘Head Scholar’s Formality’ will be applied sequentially following the June 9 (Tue) server patch. However, please note that the text description will be updated during the June 24 (Wed) maintenance.: ✦ Notes
During the server patch, you may be disconnected from the game temporarily. If this occurs, please reconnect to continue playing normally.

The server patch will be applied sequentially, and the timing may vary depending on your connection status.: We will continue to do our best to provide a more stable gameplay environment.: Thank you.

Greetings, Star Guardians!
Here are the details for 「Beyond the Sandstorm」 Version 1.5 Update.
\[「Beyond the Sandstorm」 Version 1.5 Content Overview]
✦ New Hero
\ Merlin

Weapon & Element: 1. Grimoire - Attacker (Cold): 2. Wand - Attacker (Lightning): 3. Staff - Burster (Fire): * You can obtain ‘\ Merlin’ from \[Merlin Pick Up – An Insatiable Hunger for Knowledge].: ✦ New Events: ※ The duration of certain events has been extended due to adjustments to the maintenance schedule. (Added on June 23 (Tue) 13:03 (UTC)): ‘Merlin Pick Up - An Insatiable Hunger for Knowledge’: Event Period: After the June 4 (Thu) Maintenance - Until the June 25 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC) June 24 (Wed)
The drop rate for ‘\ Merlin’ is increased in \[An Insatiable Hunger for Knowledge].
The \[An Insatiable Hunger for Knowledge] draw can be performed using ‘Hero Pick Up Draw Tickets’.

‘Merlin’s Potential Point’ can be purchased up to 2 times per server at any time in the \ → \[Exchange Shop] → \[Star Trace Crystalloid] tab at any time, and will no longer be available once the corresponding Hero Pick Up ends.: ‘Exclusive Skin - Sacred Treasure: Morning Star Aldan’: Event Period: After the June 4 (Thu) Maintenance - Until the June 25 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC) June 24 (Wed)
The ‘Morning Star Aldan’ obtainable as a Top Tier Reward from \[Sacred Treasure: Morning Star Aldan] is a Weapon Skin for the hero ‘Merlin’ and can be equipped to ‘\ Merlin’.

All rewards, including the Outfit Skin ‘Witch's Banquet’ and Weapon Skin ‘Morning Star Aldan’ of ‘\ Merlin’, are guaranteed within 10 draws.: * ‘Skins’ only change appearance when equipped and do not affect stats, skill effects, or any other attributes.

The first draw is free, and from the second draw onward, you can perform draws using ‘Exclusive Skin Draw Tickets’.: ‘Daisy Pick Up - A Timeless Heart’: Event Period: After the June 4 (Thu) Maintenance - Until the June 25 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC) June 24 (Wed)
The drop rate for ‘\ Daisy’ is increased in \[A Timeless Heart].

The \[A Timeless Heart] draw can be performed using ‘Hero Pick Up Draw Tickets’.: ‘Exclusive Skin - The Fresh Scent of Autumn’: Event Period: After the June 4 (Thu) Maintenance - Until the June 25 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC) June 24 (Wed)
The ‘Autumn Scent’ obtainable as a Top Tier Reward from \[The Fresh Scent of Autumn] is an Outfit Skin for the hero ‘Daisy’ and can be equipped to ‘\ Daisy’.

All rewards, including the Outfit Skin ‘Autumn Scent’ and Weapon Skin ‘Key of Time’ of ‘\ Daisy’, are guaranteed within 10 draws.: * The ‘Key of Time’ can be equipped as a ‘Sword and Shield’ weapon on ‘\ Daisy’.: * ‘Skins’ only change appearance when equipped and do not affect stats, skill effects, or any other attributes.
The first draw is free, and from the second draw onward, you can perform draws using ‘Exclusive Skin Draw Tickets’.

If you have partially progressed through the draw for \[The Fresh Scent of Autumn] previously, your draw progress information will carry over when it opens.: * Ex) If you have previously completed up to the 5th draw for \[The Fresh Scent of Autumn], this \[The Fresh Scent of Autumn] will open, allowing you to proceed from the 6th draw.: * If you have already performed the free draw (1st draw) in the previous \[The Fresh Scent of Autumn], an additional free draw will not be provided.: ‘Hero Merlin Trial Event’: Event Period: After the June 4 (Thu) Maintenance - Until the June 25 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC) June 24 (Wed)
Try out ‘\ Merlin’ and complete the challenge to earn rewards such as Star Fragments and Supreme Mastery EXP.

The trial dungeon hero is fully upgraded, with only Outfit and Weapon Skins applied.: The Crimson Boar Appears - Update Celebration Check-In Event: Event Period: After the June 4 (Thu) Maintenance - Until the July 15 (Wed) Maintenance (UTC)
During the event period, you can obtain generous growth materials, such as Brilliant Engraving Seals and Large Cube Key Bundles, simply by checking in for 14 days.
The Check-In Event resets every day at 07:00 (UTC).: ‘Raid Missions - Conqueror’s Path’: Event Period: After the June 4 (Thu) Maintenance - Until the June 25 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC) June 24 (Wed)
By completing Challenge and Raid Missions in \[Raid Missions - Conqueror’s Path], you can claim rewards for each completed mission.
Once all Raid Missions are cleared and final progress is reached, the final completion reward can be claimed.: ✦ New Content: Main Quest Act 14
The Main Quest Act 14 will be added.
A new region, ‘Sealed Sanctuary’, will be added alongside the Main Quest.: New Raid ‘Taranis's Sanctuary’ Added

The new content ‘Raid’ will be added, and the Raid ‘Taranis’s Sanctuary’ \ will be open.: * Raid will be unlocked upon completing the Main Quest ‘A Common Goal’.: * You can enter by selecting the \ tab at the bottom of the \[Menu (☰)].
Raid content, including ‘Taranis's Sanctuary’, can be played with 1 to 5 players.: * Raid can only be entered in a world with World Level 4 or higher.
You can obtain rewards up to 2 times a week, and reset every Monday at 07:00 (UTC).: * Up to 2 ‘Mystic Keys’ are provided per week and reset every Monday at 07:00 (UTC).

By playing the Raid ‘Taranis's Sanctuary’, you can obtain 1,000 ‘Star Fragments’ and ‘Mystic Tokens’ as First-Time Rewards, as well as 1,000 ‘Star Fragments’ and the new equipment ‘Greedy Ruler’ as Elite and Boss Clear Rewards.: * The Raid First-Time Reward can be claimed only once per account.

‘Mystic Tokens’ obtained through Raid gameplay can be exchanged for the items below in the Raid Exchange Shop.: * You can access the Raid Exchange Shop by selecting the reward icon at the bottom of the ‘Taranis’s Sanctuary’ main screen.
\[Weapon Skins] Inferno Dragon's Sacred Scale x1 (Staff)
\[Weapon Skins] Breath of the Death God x1 (Grimoire)
\[Weapon Skins] Glory of the Conqueror x1 (Greatsword)
\[Reward Chest] SSR Crafted Weapon Selection Chest x1
\ Master Tailor's Stitching Needle x3
\ Engraver's Fabric Scissors x5
\ Tailor's Stitching Needle x20
\[Reward Chest] Element Spell Bead Selection Chest x15

\ Platinum Ingot x50: * Weapon Skin products can be purchased up to 1 time per account.: * All Exchange Shop products other than Weapon Skins represent the maximum monthly exchange limits, and the exchange count resets on the 1st of every month at 07:00 (UTC).: Leaderboard Pre-Season 2 Open
Pre-Season Period: After the June 4 (Thu) Maintenance - Until the June 25 (Thu) Maintenance (UTC) June 24 (Wed)
During the Pre-Season period, Leaderboards for Boss Challenges and Timespace Junction will be available.: * Boss Challenge: \ ‘「Corrupted」 Warden Orgot’: Timespace Junction: Sectors 5 & 6

Leaderboards can be viewed from the bulletin board in the East District of ‘Liones Castle’ or by selecting the \ tab at the bottom of the \[Menu (☰)]. Records from party play will not be included in the Leaderboard rankings.: * A Leaderboard button will be added to the main entry screen of the applicable content, allowing you to check the Leaderboards immediately.: * If you leave after clearing but before the content is fully processed as complete, the record will not be reflected on the Leaderboard.

If clear times are identical, the same rank will be displayed, and the order will be sorted based on detailed clear times not displayed in-game, team Combat Class, and other factors.: * Leaderboards cannot be viewed during the season end period.

After the end of the Pre-Season, Star Guardians who achieve certain rankings will receive special Title rewards.: * Existing clear records for Dungeons and Boss Challenges will be reset at the start of the Pre-Season.: * Ranking rewards will be sent to your mailbox after the season ends.: * Ranking rewards for \[Leaderboard Pre-Season 2] will be distributed via the mailbox during the June 25 (Thu) maintenance. (Added on June 24 (Wed) 05:12 (UTC)): Boss Challenge ‘「Corrupted」 Guardian Golem’ \ & \ Difficulties Added
\ and \ difficulties will be added to the Boss Challenge ‘「Corrupted」 Guardian Golem’.
Upon clearing the \ difficulty for the first time, you can obtain ‘Star Fragments’ and ‘SSR Magic Crystal Shards’ as First-Time Rewards.

You can obtain the new armor ‘Ferocious Watcher’ as a boss clear reward.: * The \ and \ difficulties will be unlocked sequentially by clearing the preceding difficulty level.: * Detailed reward information can be checked in-game.: Timespace Junction Sectors 5 & 6 Unlock
Sectors 5 and 6 of ‘Timespace Junction’ will be unlocked sequentially as follows: * Sector 5: June 10 (Wed) 07:00 (UTC): Sector 6: June 17 (Wed) 07:00 (UTC): New Engraved Equipment Added
Engraved Equipment will be added for existing heroes.
Heroes receiving Engraved Equipment: Dreyfus, Hendrickson, Jericho, Mannie, Escanor, Clotho: New Craftable Items Added
New craftable items, weapons, and armor have been added.

Ferocious Watcher Bottoms
Ferocious Watcher Combat Boots: Other New Content

New Achievements related to Main Quests, Merlin, and Taranis’s Sanctuary will be added to the \, \, and \ tabs in Achievements.
A feature allowing the gathering of dropped Minerals will be added to the ‘Fast Mining’ skill of the pet ‘Mobile Mining Machine’.
1 new capturable pet will be added.

Lizard Egg

Fox Fur: \[Content & System Improvements]: [p align="start"]✦ ‘Star Trace Crystalloid’ Distribution Method Revamp: [p align="start"]- ‘Star Trace Crystalloids’ will be granted when obtaining additional Potential Points through Mastery completion after reaching the maximum Potential tier.: [p align="start"]* \ Regular Heroes: 5 ‘Star Trace Crystalloids’: [p align="start"] \ Regular & Pick Up Heroes: 20 ‘Star Trace Crystalloids’: [p align="start"]- ‘Star Trace Crystalloids’ will be granted when obtaining a hero through the \[120th Draw Bonus] in Hero Pick Ups.: [p align="start"]* Before reaching the maximum Potential tier for an \ Pick Up Hero: 10 ‘Star Trace Crystalloids’: [p align="start"] After reaching the maximum Potential tier for an \ Pick Up Hero: 20 ‘Star Trace Crystalloids’: [p align="start"]- For Star Guardians who obtained additional Potential Points or acquired Pick Up Heroes through the \[120th Draw Bonus] prior to the June 4 (Thu) maintenance, the unreceived amount of ‘Star Trace Crystalloids’ based on the revamped distribution method will be distributed in bulk sequentially during the June 4 (Thu) maintenance. (Added on June 4 (Thu) 10:11 (UTC)): [p align="start"]※ If you have already received ‘Star Trace Crystalloids’ based on the changed criteria during the error period, the corresponding amount will be deducted prior to distribution to prevent duplicate rewards.: [p align="start"]: [p align="start"]✦ Dungeon & Boss Challenge Revamps: [p align="start"]- After the June 4 (Thu) maintenance, the existing Dungeons ‘Ferzen Mines’ and ‘Deep Spider Nest’ will be removed from Dungeons.: [p align="start"]* ‘Ferzen Mines’ and ‘Deep Spider Nest’ are planned to be reopened after being revamped at a later date.: [p align="start"]- Existing equipment rewards obtainable as clear rewards from ‘Ferzen Mines’, ‘Deep Spider Nest’, and ‘The Capital of the Dead’ will be moved to Boss Challenges.: [p align="start"]* Details regarding the relocation of existing equipment rewards from ‘The Capital of the Dead’ have been added. (Updated on June 4 (Thu) 05:09 (UTC)): [p align="start"]- The ‘Pet Spider’ reward obtainable from ‘Deep Spider Nest’ will be moved to the rewards for the Boss Challenge ‘「Corrupted」 Ancient Dragon’.: [p align="start"]- The difficulty of the Dungeon ‘The Capital of the Dead’ will be lowered, and its First-Time Rewards and boss clear rewards will be changed.: ✦ Changes to Materials in Certain Crafting Recipes & Exchanges Added

Materials for crafting recipes that previously required materials obtainable from ‘Ferzen Mines’, ‘The Capital of the Dead’, and ‘Deep Spider Nest’ will be changed to materials obtainable from Boss Challenges.
Twisted Wish Bottoms / Combat Boots
Revived Nightmare Top / Combat Boots
Star Guardian Bottoms / Combat Boots
Hymn of Regeneration Earrings / Necklace / Ring
Arachne's Melody Bottoms / Belt / Combat Boots
Life Crystal Bottoms / Belt
Gluttonous Soul Rapier
Breath of Glory Longsword / Dual Swords / Gauntlets / Sword and Shield / Rapier / Lance

Pet Spider: * The materials ‘Mysterious Source of the Long-dead’, ‘Shakeera's Curse’, ‘Intact Magic Bead Decoration’ will be replaced with ‘Evil Eye of Madness’, ‘Dragon's Fire Sac’, ‘Warden's Bound Spirit’, ‘Packed Magic Core’, ‘Drake's Magic-infused Horns’, and ‘Awakened Remnants of the Holy War’.: * Detailed information on the changed materials can be checked at the Workbench in-game.

Items will be added to the Workbench to allow you to exchange currently owned materials from ‘Ferzen Mines’, ‘The Capital of the Dead’, and ‘Deep Spider Nest’ for other materials.: ✦ Boss Challenge Missions Added

Missions for the \ difficulty, which grant ‘Star Fragments’ as rewards, will be added to the Boss Challenges ‘「Corrupted」 Guardian Golem’, ‘「Corrupted」 Warden Orgot’, ‘「Corrupted」 Ancient Dragon’, and ‘Galland of 「Truth」’.
A reward icon will be added to the bottom left of the main screen for each Boss Challenge. By selecting this icon, you can check the missions and rewards.

Boss Challenge missions can be cleared by completing them in single-player mode, and rewards can be obtained up to 1 time.: * Mission rewards are automatically granted upon completing the mission in the \ difficulty of the corresponding Boss Challenge.: ✦ Elite Monster ‘Cube Key’ Usage Improvements

Improved so that ‘Cube Keys’ are no longer consumed to open reward cubes obtained after defeating Elite Monsters in the field.: * Along with the ‘Cube Key’ usage improvement, ‘Gold’ and ‘Mastery EXP’ reward items will be removed from Elite Monster reward cubes.: ✦ ‘Cube Key’ Multi-Use Feature Added

A feature will be added allowing you to use double the required ‘Cube Keys’ when claiming rewards, granting 2 clears’ worth of rewards for a single clear.: * When selecting ‘Use 2 times’, rewards will be calculated individually based on the rate info, and you will receive two sets of rewards.: ✦ ‘Timespace Junction’ Improvements

Improved so that the recommended Hero Info, which was previously provided per season for ‘Timespace Junction’, is now provided for each individual floor.: ✦ ‘Achievements’ Rewards Added & Mission Changes
The cumulative Achievement score required to obtain ‘Star Fragment’ rewards upon completing Achievements will be expanded from 240 to 400.

As the Dungeons ‘Ferzen Mines’ and ‘Deep Spider Nest’ are being removed, the ‘Breaking Rocks and Records’ and ‘Too Fast for Spiders’ missions will be changed.: * Detailed mission requirements can be checked in-game under \ - \.

The requirements for the ‘The Real Dungeon Boss’, ‘Unrivaled Heroes’, ‘Through Hell’, and ‘Through the Abyss’ Achievements will be changed to also include clearing the Gold Dungeon and Mastery Growth Dungeon.: * This change will also apply equally to Daily Missions, Hawk Pass, and Hero’s Path, which feature identical missions.
Changed so that the completion count for an Achievement mission will now carry over to the next tier of that mission upon completion.
The completion requirements for certain Achievements will be eased.: ✦ Equipment Balance Revamp
Changed so that when Engraved Equipment is equipped, a Top / Bottoms / Belt / Combat Boots can be equipped in addition to Accessories, allowing equipment set effects to be applied together.

Changed so that crafted equipment previously obtained with fixed quality will now be obtained with a random quality within a specific range when crafted.: * The fixed quality of the corresponding crafted equipment will be set as the minimum quality.
New Secondary Bonuses will be added to the ‘Gluttonous Soul Longsword / Axe / Sword and Shield / Rapier’ weapons.
Longsword - Attack Increase
Axe - Crit Damage
Sword and Shield - Ultimate Move Damage Increase
Rapier - Wind Attribute Burst Efficiency

As it is now possible to equip armor parts simultaneously while Engraved Equipment is equipped, the balance of certain equipment will be adjusted.: 1.
